caption: The drawing depicts a single, elaborately designed teapot rendered in shades of gray, likely created using pencil or graphite. The teapot has an angular, scalloped, and somewhat rectangular body with vertical panels and ornate edge detailing. The handle is large, curved, and has decorative flourishes, while the spout is long, slender, and narrows to a point. The lid is centrally placed, topped with a finial that consists of a round base and a pointed tip. Decorative motifs, such as fine leafy garlands and a crest or shield containing an ornate script letter, embellish the surface of the teapot. The background is plain with a slight tan hue, with the artist's name, "EUGENE LA FORET.," printed in the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Teapot
